article_bedroom.summary: Your bedroom is your own little world. After reading this, you can name the things in a bedroom, say what each one is for, and keep your room clean and happy on your own.
article_bedroom.title: What's Inside My Bedroom?

article_robot_wanted_a_friend.summary: A small robot called Bit leaves the workshop to find a friend, and nothing goes the way it planned. Follow him through the street, the rain and the park at night. After reading, you can retell the adventure, use five new robot words in your own sentences, and explain how Bit finally made a friend.
article_robot_wanted_a_friend.title: The Robot Who Wanted a Friend
